'''Haune Tiar''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who headed the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi Enclave (Ossus)|enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]<ref name="Datacron" /> around [[24,953 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Timeline 15: The Jedi Join the Republic]] provides 21,300 BTC as the date when the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] began in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], which is 1,347 BTC in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'', so the difference between the calendar based on the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the calendar based on the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] is 3,653 [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. This allows to place the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] joining the Republic in [[24,953 BBY]].</ref> when [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] from the newly-formed [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] linked Ossus to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] with the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. Tiar returned with the scouts to the Core Worlds, and, during his tour of the Republic, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Force vision/Legends|foresaw]] that the Order would need to be the Republic's protectors. Returning to Ossus, Tiar discussed the matter with the rest of the enclave for several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] before declaring that they would become guardians of the Republic.<ref name="Datacron" />

==Behind the scenes==
Haune Tiar was first mentioned in the Codex entry "Galactic History 12" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Datacron" />
